title: Redo Replacement Picking on 96 Well Plate
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter worklist parameters
steps.instruction: Provide the Redo Replacement worklist as a CSV with columns: Number of Redo, pos TB_RCK_1, pos MTP_1, disposal_vol, transfer_vol, TUBE BAR, PLATE BAR. Example rows: 1,1,200,200; 2,35,200,200; 3,2,150,200; 4,90,100,100; 5,84; 6,62; 7,42; 8,18.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file from the provided link and unzip it if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware (if needed)
steps.instruction: In the OT App, navigate to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select any required labware JSON files.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: In the OT App's Protocol tab, upload the .py protocol file.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette using the OT App calibration workflow (refer to support articles for calibration tips).

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press 'Run' to start the Redo Replacement Picking protocol.
